headline: CLOVE newly crossed its kill line (mcap ~150.9k under 160k) and moves from Watch to Pass; BOLT sits deeper under its lines (mcap ~163.9k, holders 255). Grumpy Walrus sold ~10.54M CITY for ~1,413 ADA at 12:28 and 1:41 PM (~47% of its bag, ~12.0M left), 7.62M Guinea Pig (~504 ADA) and 5M CHEESE (~365 ADA), likely pulled COCK LP (~844 ADA + ~188.7k COCK), added ~716 NIGHT and small COCK and VAL clips, and sent ~2.8k ADA to outside wallets; net ADA ~+167. CITY failed the SW-01 gate (pool side ~13.3k, under 25k, and Grumpy Walrus selling). GG and MIXI are new swarm launches with no DEX pool: Pass. Nothing passes k/y; no SW-01 ticket.
learned: Lessons: Grumpy Walrus bought CITY in the first hour and sold ~47% of it about 25 hours after launch, so a tracked whale buying before the SW-01 gate says little about it still holding after the gate.
